lawful_gt0_avoidance_or_fallback: Use one exact source/measure or remain source-indexed without asserting portability; otherwise emit noncomparable/unavailable/blocked state
current_evidence_or_owner: P3 source-universe law proves neighboring jurisdictions but no current governed measurement-portability owner
closure_requirement: Competent portability requirement/owner/evidence decision at exact operation/scope
note: Not a global blocker for a single-source GT0 path

current_evidence_or_owner: Dva/P3 inheritance plus current FIELD FORGE representation/transport law preserve representation-vs-authority separation
closure_requirement: Terminal source geometry/equivalence reconciliation with competent exact owner/map/comparator/falsifier authority
note: Depends on OBL012 where measurement portability is also required

lawful_gt0_avoidance_or_fallback: Retain source snapshots; use exact persistent or source-backed carrier only as an execution realization; no retirement claim

closure_requirement: Exact production source→carrier equivalence proof plus separately competent source-retirement/cutover authority
note: Does not block GT0 while source evidence remains retained and exact replay is available

note: Exact query capability survives independently of this generalized discovery gate

note: Does not block noncomposite GT0 path
